Our Company is currently the largest private player in Mumbai, the second largest private player in Pune and the third largest private player in Nagpur.
Our Company is the largest private player in the UHT milk market.
We have applied for, but not yet obtained registration with respect to certain trademarks, copyrights and designs.
We may not be able to prevent infringement of our trademarks and a passing off action may not provide sufficient protection until such time that this registration is granted.
We own a number of trademarks in India relating to our name and several of our products, including ‘Gowardhan’ and ‘Go’, and we have filed applications for registration of certain other trademarks.
There are outstanding criminal proceedings against our Company, our Promoters and one of our Directors.

The criminal proceedings against our Company and our Promoters are in relation to contravention of Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction of Sale) Regulations, 2011, Food Safety and Standards (Food Product Standards & Additives) Regulations, 2011 and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Additionally, there is also an outstanding criminal proceeding against one of our Independent Directors pending before the Bombay High Court.
